active_scope: Existing git tracked plus nonignored untracked regular files; deleted entries skipped; archive, .git, dependency directories and explicitly announced concurrent files excluded.
metadata_scope: All regular files including hidden files, ZIP payloads and metadata documents; hierarchy including empty directories; file/directory attributes, creation and last-write UTC times. Access times, ACL ownership and alternate-stream inventories are not asserted.
tree_sha256_format: UTF-8 without BOM; sorted relative_path + TAB + decimal bytes + TAB + lowercase SHA256, LF joined without trailing LF.
limitations: Copies external snapshots and fixed committed baseline only; no guarantee of recovering uncommitted intermediate rewrites. No payload execution or extraction.
